sub: Week 11, Thu Nov 5 to Fri Nov 13. Groceries arrive Fri.

days.note: Today's breakfast, school lunches and lunch are already done. Tonight is the crockpot chicken with pepper rice, and tomorrow gets set up.
am: The whole chicken is in the crockpot (low). Check it reaches 165 in the thickest part of the thigh around 4:30.
Tomorrow's groceries arrive Fri between 10 am and 1 pm. Clear a little fridge and freezer space tonight.
pm: 5:00 pm: sauté the peppers and start the pepper rice, and roast the broccoli (20 minutes) while the chicken rests.
After dinner: pull ALL the leftover chicken off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 4 cups: 2 for Friday's alfredo, 1 for the adult wraps, 1 for the kid boxes).
Tonight: mix the adult chicken salad (1 cup chicken, mayo, mustard, celery, lemon) so Friday morning is just packing.
Tonight: set out the grits, cheddar and 2 bananas for Friday breakfast, and check the apples, string cheese and Cheez-Its for Friday's lunch box.

days.note: Breakfast and school lunches use what is in the house. The groceries arrive mid-day, so dinner and the after-school snack can use them.
am: Make the cheesy grits (about 25 minutes) with banana slices.
Pack school lunches from what is on hand: the chicken boxes (chicken, cheddar cubes, Cheez-Its, apple slices) and a pretzel and string cheese snack. Adults eat the chicken wraps at home.
Groceries due 10 am to 1 pm: put the frozen items away first (the 2 boxes of banana bites go straight in the freezer), then the cold items. Set the ground turkey aside to cook Sunday (or freeze it).
Take the frozen cheese pizzas off the order if they are still in the cart (see the Shopping tab).
pm: 4:45 pm: roast the broccoli, boil the fettuccine and make the alfredo sauce (25 minutes).
After dinner: oven to 375 and bake the peach crisp (35 minutes) while you clean up. Serve warm.
Tonight: move the frozen salmon from the freezer to the fridge to thaw for Saturday.
meals: Chicken salad wraps (adults) and kid chicken boxes
One pot plus a sheet pan, 25 minutes
Peach crisp with protein oat topping

days.note: Everyone is home, so brownies bake in the morning and dinner is a 25 minute salmon sheet pan.
am: Make the scrambled eggs and toast for breakfast (about 10 minutes).
Check that the salmon is thawed in the fridge.
Bake the protein brownie bites after breakfast (16 to 18 minutes) so they cool before dessert.
Make the shells and cheese for lunch with steamed broccoli and apple slices.
pm: 4:45 pm: oven to 425, roast the frozen stir-fry veggies and the glazed salmon on two pans and start the rice (25 minutes).
Tonight: nothing to prep. Sunday is a slower day.
meals: Shells and cheese with broccoli and apple slices
Soy-maple salmon over rice with roasted veggies

days.note: A relaxed day for a bigger cook. The meatball batch makes tonight's dinner AND Monday's quick therapy-night dinner.
am: Make the pancakes (about 25 minutes) with yogurt, banana and a little maple.
Hard-boil 6 eggs for the snack lunch (10 minutes), cool and peel.
Take the slider rolls out of the freezer and put them in the fridge tonight.
pm: 3:30 pm: mix and roll the turkey meatballs (about 30) and bake them on two pans. Cook the ground turkey today or freeze it.
5:00 pm: boil the spaghetti, roast the broccoli and warm the sauce. Serve 15 meatballs and refrigerate the other 15 plus 1 jar of sauce within 2 hours for Monday.
After dinner: oven to 350 and bake the frozen berry crisp (30 to 35 minutes). Serve warm.
Tonight: assemble the 5 jars of Maple Brown Sugar overnight oats for Monday.
meals: White cheddar popcorn, cheese and grapes
Turkey meatballs with spaghetti and roasted broccoli
Frozen berry crisp with protein oat topping

days.note: Anna is out tonight, so dinner is 15 minutes using Sunday's meatballs. Easy for whoever is home.
am: Grab the Maple Brown Sugar oat jars and top with chopped pecans and a tiny maple drizzle.
Make the cheese quesadillas for lunch (10 minutes), wrap in foil and pack with the dip and carrots.
Pack the snacks: mandarin and string cheese in the morning, carrots, ranch dip and pretzels for after school.
Check that the slider rolls are thawed in the fridge.
pm: 3:45 pm: make the chocolate protein pudding (5 minutes, then chill). Scoop the picky eater a portion first and stir in vanilla almond creamer instead of the yogurt.
4:30 pm: warm the meatballs in the marinara, toast the rolls with mozzarella and fill the sliders (15 minutes). Dinner is ready before Anna heads out.
Tonight: assemble the 5 yogurt parfait cups for Tuesday breakfast.
meals: Cheese quesadillas with ranch dip and carrots
Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
15 minutes, easy for whoever is home

days.note: The taco chicken cooks itself all day. Tonight is build-your-own and the leftovers cover Thursday.
am: Chicken thighs into the slow cooker by 9:30 with the spices and salsa, low for 6 to 7 hours.
Breakfast is the parfait cups from last night. Grab and go.
Make the grilled cheese for lunch, wrap in foil and pack with carrots and a mandarin.
pm: 5:00 pm: shred the chicken, warm the tortillas and set out the toppings (15 minutes).
After dinner: refrigerate the leftover chicken (about 2 1/2 cups) within 2 hours for Thursday.
Tonight: assemble the 5 jars of Peanut Butter Banana overnight oats for Wednesday.
meals: Greek yogurt parfaits with granola and banana
Aldi frozen PB chocolate banana bites

days.note: Oats are ready, and dinner is garlic butter shrimp that has been waiting in the freezer.
am: Grab the Peanut Butter Banana oat jars and top with banana slices and chocolate chips.
Cook the ditalini and toss with marinara and cheese. Pack the middle and youngest lunches in a thermos with carrot sticks.
Move the shrimp from the freezer to the fridge to thaw (or use a bowl of cold water for 20 minutes before cooking).
Pack the snacks: rice cake and peanut butter in the morning, carrots and ranch dip for after school.
pm: 3:30 pm: blend and bake the chocolate banana protein muffins (20 minutes).
4:45 pm: start the rice, roast the sweet potatoes and broccoli at 425 (25 minutes), then sear the shrimp in garlic butter for the last 5 minutes.
Tonight: bake the egg and pepper muffins for Thursday breakfast (20 minutes), cool and refrigerate.
meals: Ditalini with marinara and cheese, carrot sticks
Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
Garlic butter shrimp over rice with roasted sweet potatoes and broccoli

days.note: The leftover taco chicken makes today's lunch and tonight's rice bowls.
am: Reheat the egg and pepper muffins in the microwave (30 seconds each) with a mandarin.
Make the chicken quesadillas for lunch, wrap in foil and pack with salsa and pepper strips.
Pack the snacks: mandarin and string cheese in the morning, popcorn, cheese and grapes for after school.
pm: 3:30 pm: blend and bake the pumpkin protein muffins (20 minutes).
4:45 pm: cook the rice, warm the chicken with the spices, warm the beans and set out the toppings (20 minutes).
Tonight: nothing to prep for tomorrow beyond setting out the bread, peanut butter and bananas.
meals: Chicken quesadillas with salsa and pepper strips
White cheddar popcorn, cheese and grapes
Chicken and black bean rice bowls (build your own)
Bean meal of the week, 20 minutes

days.note: Last day of the plan. The potatoes bake themselves and everyone loads their own.
am: Make the peanut butter banana toast and set out a yogurt cup for each person.
Make the tortilla pizzas for lunch (8 minutes at 425), cool and pack with pepper strips.
Pack the snacks: apple slices and string cheese in the morning, pretzels, string cheese and a mandarin for after school.
Scrub and prick the potatoes and have them ready to bake at 4:00.
pm: 4:00 pm: potatoes in the oven at 425 (50 to 60 minutes).
5:00 pm: steam the broccoli and set out the cheese and yogurt toppings.
After dinner: potatoes are out, so drop the oven to 350 and bake the apple crisp (35 minutes). Serve warm.
After dinner: eyeball what is left in the fridge and pantry for next week's ledger.
meals: Peanut butter banana toast with a yogurt cup
Apple crisp with protein oat topping

chicken_cp.t: Crockpot whole chicken, pepper rice and roasted broccoli
chicken_cp.s: Serves 6 with leftover chicken for Friday
ing: 1 whole chicken, 5 to 6 lb, raw and thawed (never frozen)
1 onion, quartered (dice a little of it for the rice)
Pepper rice: 2 cups long grain white rice, 3 bell peppers diced small, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 4 cups water, 1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt for the broccoli
st: Put the onion in the slow cooker. Pat the chicken dry, rub with the oil and spices and set it breast side up on the onion. Pour the water around it.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours (or high 4 to 5) until 165 in the thickest part of the thigh.

Pepper rice: heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a lidded pot over medium. Sauté the diced peppers (and a little diced onion if you like) 5 to 6 minutes until soft with a few browned edges. Stir in the garlic powder and salt, add the rice and stir 1 minute to toast it.

Add the 4 cups water and the butter, bring to a boil, cover, turn to low and cook 15 to 18 minutes without lifting the lid. Rest off the heat 5 minutes, then fluff. For more chicken flavor, swap 1/2 cup of the water for skimmed crockpot juices.
Roast the frozen broccoli at 425 with the oil and salt for 18 minutes. Let the chicken rest 15 minutes and serve legs, thighs and some breast.
After dinner pull ALL the remaining meat off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 4 cups: 2 for Friday's chicken salad lunch and 2 for Friday's alfredo).

ing: 1 cup shredded cheddar (grate from the block)
st: Boil the water with the salt, whisk in the grits and simmer on low 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the olive oil, cheddar and garlic powder until melted.
Serve with banana slices on the side.
Pack or plate as listed.

chicken_wraps.t: Chicken salad wraps (adults) and kid chicken boxes
chicken_wraps.s: Serves 6 (2 adults, 3 kid boxes plus a spare)
ing: Adult wraps: 1 cup chopped chicken (from Thursday's crockpot chicken), 1/4 cup mayo, 1 tbsp grainy mustard, 2 celery ribs diced, 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt and pepper, 2 large tortillas
Kid boxes: 1 cup shredded plain chicken, 1 cup cheddar cubes, 1 1/2 cups Cheez-Its, 2 apples, sliced
st: Stir the salad ingredients together, spoon into the tortillas, roll up and cut in half.
Divide the kid chicken, cheese, Cheez-Its and apple slices into boxes. Keep the chicken cold in the lunchbox.
Pack or plate as listed.

alfredo.t: Chicken fettuccine alfredo with roasted broccoli
ing: 2 cups shredded chicken (from Thursday's crockpot chicken)
1 can (12 oz) fat free evaporated milk
st: Roast the broccoli on a sheet pan at 425 with the olive oil and a pinch of salt for 18 minutes.
Boil the fettuccine and drain.
Whisk the cornstarch into the evaporated milk, warm it with the butter and garlic powder over medium, stir 3 to 4 minutes until thick, then stir in the Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Toss the pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve with broccoli.

ing: 1 cup shredded cheddar (grate from the block)
st: Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low, add the eggs and stir gently until almost set, then fold in the cheese and take off the heat.
Serve with toast and a mandarin.
Spread and top.

shells.t: Shells and cheese with broccoli and apple slices
ing: 2 boxes (about 6 oz each) shells and cheese
Milk and butter as the box directs (use 2% milk)
st: Make the shells and cheese as the box directs.
Steam the broccoli 5 minutes and stir half of it into the pasta.
Serve with the rest of the broccoli and apple slices.
Pack or plate as listed.

salmon.t: Soy-maple salmon over rice with roasted veggies
ing: 2 lb salmon fillets, thawed in the fridge
1 bag frozen stir-fry veggies, roasted (not stir-fried)
1 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt for the veggies
2 cups long grain white rice and 4 cups water
st: Heat the oven to 425. Cook the rice.
Roast the frozen veggies on one pan with 1 tbsp oil and the salt for 15 to 18 minutes.
Whisk the aminos, maple, 1 tbsp oil and garlic powder, put the salmon on a second pan and brush on the glaze. Roast 10 to 12 minutes until it flakes (145). Serve over rice with the veggies.

ing: 3 tbsp melted butter or olive oil
1 1/4 cups plain Greek yogurt (1/4 cup each)
Maple syrup and 1 banana, sliced, for topping
st: Whisk the dry ingredients. Whisk the milk, eggs, butter and vanilla, then stir into the dry just until combined.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a medium skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Serve each plate with a dollop of yogurt for protein, banana slices and a little maple syrup.
Pack the granola separately.

ing: 3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt mixed with 1 tbsp ranch seasoning, for dipping
st: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool in ice water and peel.
Put everything out on a platter or cutting board so everyone builds their own plate.

s_popcorn.t: White cheddar popcorn, cheese and grapes
st: Pack or plate as listed.

meatballs.t: Turkey meatballs with spaghetti and roasted broccoli
meatballs.s: Serves 6, plus 15 extra meatballs and 1 jar of sauce for Monday
ing: 1 tbsp olive oil for the pans
1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt for the broccoli
st: Heat the oven to 400 and oil two sheet pans.
Mix the turkey, oats, milk, eggs and seasonings gently with your hands (do not overmix). Roll into about 30 golf-ball-size meatballs and divide between the pans.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until 165 inside. Roast the broccoli on a third pan or between the meatballs for the last 18 minutes.
Boil the spaghetti and drain. Warm 1 jar of marinara and toss half the sauce through the pasta.
Serve 15 meatballs over spaghetti with extra sauce and the broccoli. Within 2 hours refrigerate the other 15 meatballs and the second jar of marinara (about 3 cups) for Monday.

ing: Pinch of salt in each jar
Topping: 10 tbsp chopped pecans or walnuts and at most 1/2 tsp extra maple per jar
st: Per jar: 3/4 cup oats, 1 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tsp maple, 3/4 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Add everything except the nuts and stir well, working the peanut butter in.
Refrigerate overnight (Sunday night).
Morning: stir, top with 2 tbsp chopped nuts and a tiny maple drizzle if needed.

quesadillas.t: Cheese quesadillas with ranch dip and carrots
ing: 2 1/2 cups shredded cheddar (grate from the block)
Dip: 1 cup plain Greek yogurt and 1 tbsp ranch seasoning
st: Sprinkle cheese over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Toast in an oiled skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side. Cut into wedges.
Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt for the dip. Serve with carrots.

s_carrot_dip.t: Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
ing: 3 tbsp ranch dip (3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt plus 1 tbsp ranch seasoning for all 5)
st: Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt and pack in small cups.

sliders.s: Serves 6 (15 minutes, easy for whoever is home)
ing: 6 slider rolls (from the freezer, thawed in the fridge overnight)
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella (grate from the block)
st: Warm the meatballs in the marinara in a covered pan over medium 10 minutes.
Split the rolls, add mozzarella and toast under the broiler 1 to 2 minutes.
Fill each roll with 2 to 3 meatballs and sauce. Serve with carrots.

parfait.t: Greek yogurt parfaits with granola and banana
st: Stir the vanilla into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt, banana and granola in cups. Assemble Monday night and keep the granola in a separate cup until morning.
Pack or plate as listed. A squeeze of lemon keeps the apple from browning.

ing: 12 thin slices cheddar (cut from the block, about 8 oz)
st: Build 6 sandwiches, butter the outsides and toast in a skillet 3 minutes per side.
Serve with carrots and a mandarin.
Pack or plate as listed.

tacos.s: Serves 6, with chicken left over for Thursday
ing: Toppings: 2 cups shredded cheddar, 1 cup salsa, 2 avocados diced, 3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt (instead of sour cream), tortilla chips
st: Morning: put the thighs in the slow cooker, sprinkle on the spices and pour the salsa and water over. Cook on low 6 to 7 hours until it shreds easily (165 minimum).
Shred the chicken in the juices. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or the microwave.
Set out the toppings so everyone builds their own tacos. Refrigerate the leftover chicken (about 2 1/2 cups) within 2 hours for Thursday.

ing: Pinch of salt in each jar
Topping: 1 banana, sliced, and optional 5 tbsp mini chocolate chips
st: Per jar: 3/4 cup oats, 1 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia, 1/2 mashed banana, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Mash the banana in the jar first, add the rest and stir well.
Refrigerate overnight (Tuesday night).
Morning: stir, top with banana slices and chocolate chips for whoever wants them.

ditalini_marinara.t: Ditalini with marinara and cheese, carrot sticks
ing: 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella (grate from the block)
st: Boil the ditalini and drain, saving 1/4 cup of the water.
Warm the marinara with the olive oil and Italian seasoning, toss with the pasta and a splash of the water.
Stir in the mozzarella until melty. Pack in a thermos with carrot sticks on the side.

shrimp.t: Garlic butter shrimp over rice with roasted sweet potatoes and broccoli
ing: 1 1/2 lb raw peeled medium shrimp, thawed (use whatever the bag holds)
2 cups long grain white rice and 4 cups water
1 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt for the veggies
st: Heat the oven to 425. Spread the sweet potatoes and broccoli on a sheet pan with the oil and salt and roast 25 minutes, stirring once. Cook the rice with the water and butter.
Pat the shrimp dry. Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high, add the shrimp and garlic powder and sear 2 minutes per side until pink.
Stir in the lemon juice, salt and pepper. Serve over rice with the veggies and spoon the pan butter over the top.

ing: 1 tbsp olive oil to grease the tin
st: Heat the oven to 375. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin with the olive oil.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt, stir in the pepper and cheese, and fill 10 cups about 3/4 full.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until set. Cool and refrigerate (made Wednesday night).
Thursday: microwave 30 seconds each and serve with a mandarin.

chicken_quesadillas.t: Chicken quesadillas with salsa and pepper strips
ing: 2 cups shredded cheddar (grate from the block)
st: Sprinkle cheese and chicken over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Toast in an oiled skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side. Cut into wedges.
Serve with salsa and pepper strips.

bowls.t: Chicken and black bean rice bowls (build your own)
bowls.s: Serves 6 (the bean meal of the week, 20 minutes)
ing: 2 cans (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
2 cups long grain white rice and 4 cups water
Toppings: 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar, 1 cup salsa, 1 avocado diced, crushed tortilla chips
st: Cook the rice. Warm the chicken in a pan with the cumin, chili powder, salt and a splash of water. Warm the beans separately.
Set everything out so each person builds a bowl (the middle kid can skip the beans).

toast_pb.t: Peanut butter banana toast with a yogurt cup
st: Spread the peanut butter on the toast and top with banana slices.
Serve each plate with a yogurt cup for extra protein.

ing: 2 cups shredded mozzarella (grate from the block)
1 bell pepper cut into strips, for the side
st: Heat the oven to 425. Put the tortillas on two sheet pans and bake 2 minutes to crisp the base.
Spread with sauce, top with cheese and seasoning and bake 6 to 8 minutes until bubbly. Cool before packing.
Serve with pepper strips.

ing: 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp salt for the potatoes
2 cups shredded cheddar (grate from the block)
1 1/2 cups plain Greek yogurt (instead of sour cream)
st: Heat the oven to 425. Scrub and prick the potatoes, rub with the oil and salt and bake directly on the rack 50 to 60 minutes until soft.
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes in the last half hour.
Split the potatoes and set out the cheese, yogurt and broccoli so everyone loads their own.
Not made. The planned pudding cups were skipped, so the pudding mix and yogurt stay on hand.

peach_crisp.t: Peach crisp with protein oat topping
ing: 2 cans (15 oz) peaches in juice, drained
Topping: 2 scoops unflavored plant protein powder
st: Heat the oven to 375. Toss the peaches with the maple, cinnamon and cornstarch in an 8 inch baking dish.
Stir the topping ingredients together, adding the milk a tablespoon at a time until it clumps like wet sand.
Crumble the topping over the peaches and bake 30 to 35 minutes, until bubbling. Serve warm.
Heat the oven to 350 and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla and yogurt, then stir in the flour, protein, cocoa, baking powder and salt. If the batter is stiff, add 1 tbsp milk. Fold in the chips.
Fill the cups and bake 16 to 18 minutes (check early, protein dries them out). Cool in the tin. Serve 2 each.

berry_crisp.t: Frozen berry crisp with protein oat topping
ing: 1 bag (16 oz) frozen mixed berries, not thawed
Topping: 2 scoops unflavored plant protein powder
st: Heat the oven to 350. Toss the frozen berries with the maple and cornstarch in an 8 inch baking dish.
Stir the topping ingredients together, adding the milk a tablespoon at a time until it clumps like wet sand.
Crumble the topping over the berries and bake 30 to 35 minutes, until bubbling. Serve warm.

ing: 1 box (1 oz) sugar-free chocolate pudding mix
For the picky eater: 2 tbsp vanilla almond creamer in place of the yogurt
st: Whisk the protein powder into the cold milk until smooth, then whisk in the pudding mix for 2 minutes. Let it rest 5 minutes to set.
Stir in the yogurt. For the picky eater, scoop out her portion first and stir in the creamer instead.
Spoon into cups, chill 10 minutes and top with chips.

aldi_bananas.t: Aldi frozen peanut butter chocolate banana bites
ing: 2 boxes Aldi Season's Choice frozen PB chocolate banana bites
st: Keep frozen until dessert. Serve about 2 pieces each, checking the box. Serving counts are Unverified (Aldi lists no per-box servings online).
Heat the oven to 350 and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Blend the bananas, yogurt, eggs and maple, then add the oats, protein, cocoa and baking powder. Blend smooth, adding the milk a tablespoon at a time until it is thick but pourable.
Stir in half the chips, fill the cups, top with the rest and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Serve 2 each.

ing: 1 cup plain canned pumpkin (not pie filling)
st: Heat the oven to 350 and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Blend the pumpkin, yogurt, eggs and maple, then add the oats, protein, baking powder and spices. Blend smooth, adding the milk a tablespoon at a time until it is thick but pourable.
Fill the cups, add chips if using, and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Serve 2 each.

apple_crisp.t: Apple crisp with protein oat topping
ing: Topping: 2 scoops unflavored plant protein powder
st: Heat the oven to 350. Toss the apples with the maple, cinnamon and water in an 8 inch baking dish and cover with foil.
Stir the topping ingredients together, adding the milk a tablespoon at a time until it clumps like wet sand.
Bake the apples covered 15 minutes, then crumble the topping over, uncover and bake 20 minutes more. Serve warm.

Crockpot chicken tacos, build your own

Frozen salmon: move to the fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner.
Slider rolls: move from the freezer to the fridge Sunday night.
